findings.title: Red runner is discoverable by bare node --test
findings.detail: checks/fixtures/execution-provider/red.test.mjs matches Node's default *.test.mjs discovery. Running `node --test` at the repository root discovers it and exits 1 (verified: X-T01 fails at red.test.mjs:8). CI uses explicit globs so this is not a CI break, but it is a developer/IDE footgun. Rename it to red.mjs or move it outside default test discovery, and update the documented command.

findings.title: Several required observations are not red-sensitive
findings.detail: The gating suite only proves sensitivity to the single injected defect per scenario; other assertions are tautological or controlled entirely by the fixture. X-T06 sets elapsed = deadline in both broken and healthy doubles, so `elapsed <= deadline` cannot fail. X-T10 hardcodes checkoutDeadline = 10. X-T03's duplicate-approval check is suppressed by the fixture's own `decided` flag rather than by a host/provider check. X-T05 records the fixture's constant invocationId instead of the call re-announced by restore, so wrong-identity lookup would still pass. X-T09 increments kills in both modes. Inject a corresponding defect for these observations or label them as non-red positive controls.

summary: Docs-only contract and red doubles are internally consistent and the new suite passes, but the raw red runner is picked up by bare node --test and several claimed red assertions are vacuous.
